text.text_excerpt: Let's be honest. Everything in Auction house market is over-priced. You are paying for CBD Tax BUT! I think Happyjaxx out of all the vendors deserves its pricing. $12 can get you a hearty, really filling bowl full of grains, greens and protein. I had Korean bibimbab salad and it was enough to share for sure. I liked it so much that I came the very next day and ordered the exact same thing. They offer different types of salad, bowls and sandwich. If you like particular ingredients more than others, you can request more of that in lieu of other ingredient. The owner customized per my request and it was perfect!

The BBQ Jack fruit sandwich is amazing! I've tried most vegan options at Auction House and this remains my favorite! My husband doesn't like jackfruit but agrees this is the best. He is also very flexible with his menu so be sure to check Happy Jaxx out.

I took my first trip to the Auction House Market today and needed a drink to quench my thirst (just finished a 3 hour walk). I can't comment on the food but the green tea lemonade was awesome. It had just the right amount of sweetness with a few green tea(?) leaves thrown in the cup to bring out the flavor. I was hoping for a sweet tea but this lemonade "hit the spot". The man behind the counter wasn't very friendly and I was the only one there during a lull in the day (post lunch crowd on a Sat) BUT the lemonade made up for it. I'd purchase another in the future. Medium cup with tax costa around $3.50.
